# Roles

| Role    | What it can do                                  |
| ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| Owner   | Everything, including billing and deleting data |
| Manager | Orders, users and reports, but not billing      |
| Viewer  | Read-only access to orders and reports          |

An account always has at least one **Owner**.
